query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.messages DESC, t.last_seen_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)::text AS "payload!" FROM ( SELECT chatter_login AS login, chatter_id AS id, first_message_at, messages, is_first_time_streamer, seen_via_chatters_api, last_seen_at FROM twitch_session_chatters WHERE session_id = $1 ) t
